about: Place names the player is told (ink UI round, gen/ui/STYLE.md 'Place notifications'). region: the large banner shown when you walk into this section's region (sections sharing a region id show it once). landmarks: a vertical name plaque stands over the map entity id as you approach (江南百景圖's plaques), and a toast with the line from the painting's reading when you come within r metres of its footprint (or its point); top: the plaque's height when the map has none. Every name and line in 繁體, from the painting and its readings; src says where. Lore (round 2, gen/ui/r2_lore.md): long is the longer description under the toast's fold and in the 圖志 journal; quote and quoteSrc an exact line from a period or scholarly source; cite the sources as the player reads them; longSrc one note per claim (never shown); crop the map IDs that frame the painting's crop (tools/place_crops.mjs). Bundled for the page by tools/ui_data.mjs into web/public/assets/ui/places.json (short) and lore.json (long, fetched when needed). Every displayed field has an English sibling `<field>_en`, shown as a gloss under the Chinese when the viewer picks 中英 (Chinese stays the default).

region.name: 郊野
region.src: map/sections.json S1 '郊野 · 古柳'; 余辉《深度游》第一段 古柳前后见清明; 《导览》 村柳前后
region.long: 畫卷由右向左展開，開卷是汴京東南的遠郊：河渠縱橫，老樹還沒抽芽，薄霧輕籠，正是早春。兩個腳夫趕著馱炭的驢隊走向小橋，農家的穀場靜悄悄的；隋堤上一排老柳，掃墓的人家抬著插滿楊柳的轎子回城。畫的是不是清明，學者有過爭論：孔憲易據炭驢、扇子和「新酒」旗，以為是秋景；金人張著的跋文落款「清明後一日」，余輝以為這已婉轉點明了時節。這裏從清明之說。
region.long_en: The scroll unrolls from right to left, and it opens in the far outskirts south-east of Bianjing: rivers and canals criss-cross, the old trees have not yet leafed, a thin mist hangs over everything, and it is early spring. Two porters drive a train of charcoal-laden donkeys toward a small bridge, and a farmer's threshing floor lies quiet. Along the Sui Embankment stands a row of old willows, and a family returning from sweeping graves carries a sedan chair stuck full of willow twigs back to town. Scholars have argued whether the painting shows Qingming at all: Kong Xianyi, citing the charcoal donkeys, the fans and the “new wine” flag, took it for autumn; the colophon by the Jin writer Zhang Zhu is signed “the day after Qingming,” which Yu Hui takes as a quiet statement of the season. Here we follow the Qingming reading.
region.quote: 凡新墳皆用此日拜掃。都城人出郊。
region.quote_en: All new graves are visited on this day. The people of the capital go out to the suburbs.
region.cite: 故宮名畫記・孔憲易・余輝〈跋文考釋〉
region.cite_en: Palace Museum, Minghuaji · Kong Xianyi · Yu Hui, Notes on the Colophons
longSrc: MHJ 1: 汴京城外东南远郊, 河渠纵横, 老树新芽未吐, 薄雾轻笼, 早春; 两个脚夫赶着几匹毛驴，驮着木炭向小桥走来
map S1.grp.charcoal_train: two drivers, five donkeys
MHJ 2 寂静的谷场; MHJ 3 隋堤; MHJ 6 杨柳杂花装簇轿顶 (扫墓回城)
SEC §1.3: 孔宪易 autumn, not Qingming (charcoal donkeys, fans, straw hats, 新酒 flags, watermelons)
COL p.60 (余辉): 张著跋文年款为"清明后一日"，婉转地确定此图所绘的时节是清明节
quote: DJ 卷七 清明节

landmarks.name: 草橋
landmarks.line: 馱炭的驢隊，正要過橋進城。
landmarks.line_en: Charcoal donkeys about to cross the bridge into town.
landmarks.src: 名画记 1 赶驴入城; 余辉 2014 送炭驴队; map: small plank bridge (草桥)
landmarks.long: 開卷第一景：一座低矮的木板橋，細木柱撐著，橋面鋪著草土，沒有護欄，橋下泊著一隻空船。兩個腳夫趕著馱炭的驢子走向小橋，前頭的腳夫一手扶著領頭驢背上的炭筐。故宮名畫記說，這些炭要運進城裏，供酒店灶下燒火；孔憲易卻拿這隊炭驢作證，說畫的是秋冬而不是清明。
landmarks.long_en: The first scene of the scroll: a low wooden plank bridge held up by slender posts, its deck laid with grass and earth and no railing, with an empty boat moored beneath it. Two porters drive charcoal-laden donkeys toward the bridge, and the one in front steadies the charcoal basket on the lead donkey's back with one hand. The Palace Museum's notes say this charcoal is bound for the town to fuel the tavern stoves, while Kong Xianyi cites this very charcoal train as proof that the painting shows autumn or winter, not Qingming.
landmarks.cite: 故宮名畫記・孔憲易・畫中所見
landmarks.cite_en: Palace Museum, Minghuaji · Kong Xianyi · What the painting shows
longSrc: map S1.str.small_bridge_36365: long low plank bridge on thin posts, deck covered with brushwood or turf, no railing; a small empty boat under it
MHJ 1: 两个脚夫赶着几匹毛驴，驮着木炭向小桥走来
map S1.fig.charcoal_driver_36797: right arm to the top of the leading donkey's load
MHJ 21: 驴队往城里运送的木炭，正是满足这些酒店所需
SEC §1.3: 孔宪易 autumn argument rests on the charcoal donkeys (among others)

landmarks.name: 穀場
landmarks.line_en: The farmyard threshing floor, quiet for now.
landmarks.src: 名画记 2 寂静的谷场
landmarks.long: 過了小橋，路邊幾間農舍，門前搭著涼棚、擺著椅凳，像是供行人歇腳的小店；時候尚早，還沒有客人。屋旁一片平整的空地便是穀場，早春時節空空蕩蕩，只立著一副木架和一根叉竿；一株截了頂的老柳，新枝像扇子般張開。故宮名畫記稱這一景為「寂靜的穀場」，余輝的小題作「曬場農舍」。
landmarks.long_en: Past the little bridge, a few farmhouses line the road, with awnings and chairs and benches in front, like a small inn for travellers to rest; it is early and there are no customers yet. The flat open ground beside them is the threshing floor, empty in early spring, with only a wooden frame and a forked pole standing on it; an old willow with its crown cut off spreads new shoots like a fan. The Palace Museum's notes call this scene “the silent threshing floor,” and Yu Hui's subtitle for it is “Drying Yard and Farmhouses.”
landmarks.cite: 故宮名畫記・余輝・畫中所見
landmarks.cite_en: Palace Museum, Minghuaji · Yu Hui · What the painting shows
longSrc: MHJ 2: 路边歇脚店，门前搭着凉棚，摆放着椅凳。时候尚早，还没有客人到来
map S1.grd.threshing_floor_35225: empty in early spring, a bench or roller frame and a forked pole
map S1.tree.willow_pollard_35128: pollarded willow, fan of long shoots
SEC §1.2: 余辉 2014 vignette 晒场农舍

landmarks.name: 隋堤煙柳
landmarks.line_en: The old willows on the bank are called the Sui Embankment.
landmarks.src: 名画记 3 隋堤烟柳; map: the willow dyke's front bank (隋堤)
landmarks.long: 汴河開鑿於隋煬帝時，沿河的堤岸便叫隋堤，堤上遍植楊柳，「隋堤煙柳」後來列為「汴京八景」之一。畫中的柳樹樹幹蒼老扭曲，枝頭卻是新抽的嫩條。故宮名畫記解釋：堤柳長到一定粗細，就砍去樹梢，砍下的枝條紮成捆，釘在兩岸防洪護堤，年年如此，才長成這副頭大身粗的模樣。
landmarks.long_en: The Bian Canal was dug in the time of Emperor Yang of Sui, so the embankment along it is called the Sui Embankment, and willows were planted all along it; “Misty Willows on the Sui Embankment” later became one of the “Eight Sights of Bianjing.” The painted willows have old, twisted trunks, but their branches carry fresh new shoots. The Palace Museum's notes explain that when embankment willows reach a certain thickness their tops are cut off, and the cut branches are tied in bundles and pinned along both banks against floods; done year after year, it gives the trees this big-headed, thick-trunked shape.
landmarks.cite: 故宮名畫記・畫中所見
landmarks.cite_en: Palace Museum, Minghuaji · What the painting shows
longSrc: MHJ 3: 人工河开通于隋炀帝时期…隋堤…盛植杨柳…"汴京八景"之一; 树干古老苍劲，枝头新发; 砍去树梢，扎成捆，钉在汴河两岸，用来防洪抗险
map S1.grd.bank_31660: raised bank of the great pollarded willows

landmarks.name: 踏青歸來
landmarks.line: 轎頂插著楊柳雜花，掃墓回城。
landmarks.line_en: Willow and flowers on the sedan's roof: back from sweeping graves.
landmarks.src: 《东京梦华录》卷七 清明节 '轿子即以杨柳杂花装簇顶上'; 名画记 6; 余辉 2014 踏青回归
landmarks.long: 一隊人馬從郊外掃墓回城：轎頂插滿楊柳，柳條一直垂到轎身，轎夫一前一後抬著；挑夫擔著箱籠，騎馬的男主人隨在隊後。轎子關著，看不見裏面的人，故宮名畫記說坐的是女主人。這正是《東京夢華錄》寫的清明風俗：城裏人出郊拜掃，回城時把楊柳雜花裝簇在轎頂上。畫面從這裏由靜轉動，人馬漸漸多了起來。
landmarks.long_en: A party is coming back to town from sweeping graves in the country: willow twigs are stuck all over the sedan's roof and hang down to its sides, carried by two bearers front and back, while a porter carries trunks on a pole and the male head of the household rides at the rear. The sedan is closed, so we cannot see who is inside; the Palace Museum's notes say it is the lady of the house. This is exactly the Qingming custom described in Dreams of Splendour of the Eastern Capital: city people go out to the suburbs to visit graves and, coming home, decorate the sedan roof with willow and mixed flowers. From here the picture turns from stillness to motion, and more and more people and horses appear.
landmarks.quote: 轎子即以楊柳雜花裝簇頂上，四垂遮映。
landmarks.quote_en: The sedan chair is decked on top with willow and mixed flowers, hanging down on all four sides to screen it.
landmarks.cite: 故宮名畫記・《東京夢華錄》・畫中所見
landmarks.cite_en: Palace Museum, Minghuaji · Dreams of Splendour of the Eastern Capital · What the painting shows
longSrc: MHJ 6: 扫墓回城…女主人的轿子以杨柳杂花装饰轿顶…男主人骑马走在队伍的后面…画面也由静到动
